decisions.reason: Despite limited recent website visibility, this two-component resin injection unit remains close to the firm's core application-equipment business, so we would keep it unless later portfolio consolidation becomes necessary.
With no recent observation and clear overlap with another resin injection unit, we would rationalize the range and discontinue this variant to free resources for stronger lines and new development.
An automatic airless spray gun fits the firm's established coating technology and industrial customer base, so we would retain it even though its market traction should continue to be reviewed.
This air-assisted airless spray-gun line covers several models in a core product category, which argues for continued support rather than withdrawal.
The data logger is less central than the firm's core mechanical equipment and, after several years without clear evidence of ongoing market presence, we would discontinue it and reallocate resources.
